**New in fork.7**
- Based on official 3.3.4 (fork.6 was on 3.3.1). This brings upstream's fixes for Iris shader packs, including the one for dark, blotchy lighting on world blocks.
- Closed singleplayer worlds are released from memory. These fixes are prepared for upstream (see PATCHES.md).
- Includes the fix for world-generation tasks that fail during chunk conversion, submitted upstream as [core !111](https://gitlab.com/distant-horizons-team/distant-horizons-core/-/merge_requests/111).
- The LOD render pass is chosen after shader mods have set theirs up, which removes Iris's "Unexpected; somehow the Opaque + Translucent pass ran with shaders on" error.

**Before you update from fork.6 or older**
- Set `_version = 5` in `config/DistantHorizons.toml`. Distant Horizons 3.3.3 and later reset a config file with an older version number to its defaults.
- Fabric: Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer is required. fork.6 accepted any version.

Checked in game on Fabric 26.3 with Sodium, Iris (default shader and Bliss) and Tellus. The Fabric 26.2 build was started to the title screen only. The NeoForge builds were built but not started.
